acceptance: Measured before/after CPU per package under GOMAXPROCS=3.
No guard or test weakened; each still fails on its mutant.
fix: One shared, immutable module read per test binary for the scanners. TestPRRefresh_*: gittest.Clone clones a local path, so git ignores --depth 1 and hardlinks the objects; measure the checkout and the generators apart, then reuse a gittest.FromTemplate fixture or run fewer generators. Bridge builds ./cmd/evolve once per test binary only with one shared dispatch root, or a root set at run time, because each build embeds -X dispatchcred.root (research R5, R7).
notes: Console route: CI gate and test system.
source: console, 2026-11-01, research PR #1230 (replaces #1227) (docs/research/ci-wall-variance-2026-11.md), operator deep-dive request
summary: 36 whole-module scan sites in 23 cmd/evolve test files; pinned tests went from 3-12 s to 21-37 s on the slow host; TestPRRefresh_* does a full git clone (61-156 s). Bridge sandbox-contract tests each build ./cmd/evolve (27-42 s to 92-98 s).
title: cmd/evolve tests read the module once per test binary, and TestPRRefresh measures its clone cost before a fixture change
